risk: Ethics or consent does not authorize public voice-biometric release
impact: Fatal to open release and current article route
current_trigger: Committee decision/reference/date and public-release consent scope are unverified
closure_evidence: Primary oversight record and retained consent or another documented lawful basis for the exact data fields, access mode, and reuse; otherwise a documented restricted/no-release decision
manuscript_control: Keep [MATERIAL GAP]; call labels pseudonymous; do not imply approval or permission

risk: Dataset is inaccessible or ambiguously reusable
current_trigger: HF is private; DOI absent; licence is other
closure_evidence: Rights clearance; component-specific licence; frozen archive; DOI; checksums; tested non-privileged access; matching citation
manuscript_control: Use release-target corpus; do not claim public/open availability

risk: Release-target and benchmark scopes remain conflated
current_trigger: 104500/213 is mixed with 102544/209 and universal 25 repetitions
closure_evidence: Hashed manifests; 1956-row repair provenance; 213-pair inventory; signed scope bridge; scope-qualified tables/figures
manuscript_control: Place scope bridge before benchmark; never interchange counts

risk: Privacy leakage or inadequate lifecycle governance
impact: Critical participant harm and release halt
current_trigger: Stable voice IDs; proposed granular demographics; no withdrawal/retention/takedown policy; incomplete image OCR coverage
closure_evidence: Approved minimized schema; whole-package leakage audit; crosswalk controls; controller/contact; lifecycle/versioning policy; residual-risk and responsible-use statements
manuscript_control: Use pseudonymous terminology; omit unsupported granular demographics

risk: Prior publication makes the data article ineligible
current_trigger: Related 2026 article is cited but raw-data and result overlap are unmapped
closure_evidence: Verified citation/DOI; release chronology; itemized overlap map; documented eligibility decision
manuscript_control: Do not present benchmark/model material as new novelty until overlap is cleared

risk: Synthetic mismatch or synthetic test rows distort attribution/evaluation
current_trigger: 132 synthetic files; 122/8/2 by split; two female-source files target M8; two synthetic test items
closure_evidence: Author disposition; row-level flags/provenance/QC; refreshed manifests and statistics; human-only and synthetic-test-excluded sensitivity results
manuscript_control: State speaker separation only for human IDs; never attribute TTS audio as the human target voice

risk: Transcript validation and the 1956-row repair are not auditable
current_trigger: Operation counts exist but reconstruction keys, normalization, hashes, and listening audit are absent
closure_evidence: Repair script and keys; source inventory; manifest; hashes/revisions; normalization rules; automated checks; audio-text audit and observed result
manuscript_control: Remove validated transcription; disclose post-freeze repair and unchanged audio shards

risk: Split supports only seen-script held-out-human-speaker inference
current_trigger: All dev/test references are represented in training according to the registry; only three human public labels occur in test; participant uniqueness is unverified; no natural female-label development/test recording source; two synthetic test items
closure_evidence: Split generator/manifests; composition table; attached overlap audit; human-only results; bounded claims; new evaluation only if broader claims are desired
manuscript_control: Call it seen-script held-out-human-label ASR technical validation; do not infer participant uniqueness or unseen-text/gender/population generalization

risk: Nine-model comparison is irreproducible or unfairly interpreted
impact: Major and possible model-paper scope drift
current_trigger: Historical run-native WER/CER used two reference normalizations/denominator sets; a uniform rescore is now attached, but model methods remain incomplete and recipes still differ in pretraining, budgets, decoding, and hardware; uncertainty/error analysis is absent
current_status: OPEN (uniform rescoring complete; method-card gate unresolved)
closure_evidence: Retain the hashed uniform rescore against the canonical test manifest; provide per-model configs/protocol, scoring implementation, error analysis, appropriate uncertainty, and same-hardware evidence for any efficiency claim
manuscript_control: Use only uniform-rescore percentages; no historical run-native rank or performance-rank column; keep compact and subordinate; describe complete-recipe outcomes, not controlled architecture effects

risk: Collection and participant methods cannot be reproduced
current_trigger: Age, room, microphone, distance, software, and protocol are conflicting or unverified; collection workflow is incomplete
closure_evidence: Primary-record evidence for recruitment, sessions, prompt presentation, instructions, recording, segmentation, naming, rejection, and verified acquisition facts
manuscript_control: Leave unresolved fields as [MATERIAL GAP] or omit; never guess

risk: Demographic dialect and representativeness claims exceed evidence
current_trigger: Twenty controlled readers and repeated prompts cannot establish national/dialect/everyday/field representativeness; label provenance is unclear
closure_evidence: Consent-compatible definitions/table or omission; authoritative age source; narrow intended-use language; explicit limitations and responsible-use exclusions
manuscript_control: Describe controlled closed-prompt read speech only

risk: Evidence provenance permits stale or unsupported claims
current_trigger: Stale gender and model-name fields; direct format, pair, overlap, repair, and sample audits are not all attached; hashes absent
closure_evidence: Hashed evidence manifest; source hierarchy/blacklist; row/header audits; overlap and sample artifacts
manuscript_control: Qualify every claim to the inspected source and scope

risk: Sampled acoustic diagnostics are generalized to the corpus
current_trigger: Only 297 sampled files and three diagnostic metrics; sampling design is not attached
closure_evidence: Sample frame, allocation, seed, manifest, code, distributions, failures, and preferably a full integrity/clipping scan plus listening audit
manuscript_control: Say 297 sampled files; not a corpus-wide quality audit; avoid stratified until evidenced

risk: Manuscript and submission package are visibly incomplete
impact: Desk return or rejection before substantive review
current_trigger: Partial Indonesian Methods; broken displays; blank keywords; missing references, declarations, DOI, and corresponding-author details
closure_evidence: Complete English template; corrected displays/references; author-approved declarations; final DOCX/PDF/link/checklist audit
manuscript_control: Keep draft marked NOT FOR SUBMISSION until all gates pass
